name: fitplay
description: FitPlay turns a TV into a body-controlled fitness arcade.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,realtime -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fitplay/web" "npm run dev -w @fitplay/realtime"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n web,realtime -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:https -w @fitplay/web" "npm run dev:https -w @fitplay/realtime"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fitplay/db && npm run build -w @fitplay/realtime && npm run build -w @fitplay/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,realtime -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @fitplay/web" "npm run start -w @fitplay/realtime"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/game/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/realtime/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @fitplay/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run vision:fetch
